skill.summary: Fetch, classify, and summarize papers from multiple sources (arXiv, etc.) with AI-powered multi-language summaries and email delivery.

latestVersion.changelog: Paper Claw sends personalized daily research digests from arXiv and beyond straight to your inbox, featuring customizable categories, intelligent classification, and agent-based multilingual summaries powered by your preferred AI via private API. Designed for researchers and AI agents, it makes paper discovery easier, smarter, and more specialized.
